ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) covering approximately 92% of the visible surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters at the distal tips and scattered across the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous clusters are located at the extreme distal tips (Left: x[0-5%], y[15-28%]; Right: x[94-100%], y[5-20%]). A distinct circular, medium-intensity mottled patch is visible on the inner-upper left lobe at x[32-37%], y[34-45%]. Scattered high-intensity point-clusters are concentrated in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 146 degrees and a depth approximately 16% of the lobe's vertical pixel span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations at distal tips corresponding to barnacle growth. The medial trailing edge displays low-frequency, low-amplitude scalloping between the tips and the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric upward concave trajectory sweeping from the central notch to the elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense concentration of roughly circular white pixel clusters on the right lobe (centered x[60-80%], y[40-65%]) and high-intensity structural clusters on the outer margins of both fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned linear white tracks (rake marks) on the upper-outer right lobe (x[82-88%], y[20-35%]) and short horizontal linear disruptions on the outer left lobe edge (x[2-8%], y[18-25%]).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring (consistent with odontocete interactions) on the right fluke lobe; heavy barnacle colonization and associated structural jaggedness on the distal trailing edges.
